description: For a repo that publishes packages (§ 5 PLX-Delivery), extended after the shared preset: a published range is a promise to every consumer, so the bot keeps it as wide as it can.

An upstream release inside the range reaches only the lock file, which owes no changeset and forces no release; a range moves only when a release falls outside it, and a peer range widens instead of moving, so consumers on the older major keep working.
